sentences.text: Once upon a time, an old man and his wife lived near the sea.
The man went out every day to catch fish in the water.
One afternoon, he caught a very strange fish that could speak.
The fish asked the man to set it free back into the water.
The kind man did not want to hurt the animal, so he let it go.
When he returned home, he told his wife about the wonderful fish.
She listened to the story with great interest and surprise.
The old man sat down and smiled at his dear wife.
He had never seen anything like that strange animal before.
The wife thought about the fish for a long time.
She believed that they might get something good from the sea.
The sun began to set behind the dark blue water.
They went to sleep and dreamed about a better life.
Morning came quickly, and the sun rose high in the sky.
The air felt warm and nice as another day began.
His wife became very angry and asked why he had not taken anything.
She wanted a better house because their old one was small and poor.
The man went back to the sea and called for the fish.
The fish gave them a nice new house immediately.
However, the woman was still not happy after a few days passed.
She wanted more power and asked her husband to make her a big leader.
She wanted control over the town and all the people.
The husband did not like this idea, but he had to go.
He walked down to the water and called out to the fish again.
The special animal made her a big leader, but she wanted even more control.
She always wanted something new and never felt happy.
The man walked home and saw his wife in her new place.
She wore fine clothes and sat on a high chair.
Many people came to see her and show respect.
Yet her heart remained cold and full of dark thoughts.
She looked at the people and told them what to do.
She finally asked to become like a god, which made the fish very angry.
When the husband returned to the sea, the weather turned bad.
The water became dark and wild as the fish took away all their things.
The man and his wife were left back in their small, poor house.
The sky turned black, and heavy rain fell down upon the land.
Strong wind blew across the water and made huge waves.
The man ran back home as fast as he could run.
All their nice things were gone, and the new house was missing.
They stood outside in the cold rain and looked around.
The wife cried because she had lost everything they got.
She realized that she had brought them bad luck.
The old man put his arm around her and said nothing.
They walked inside the small room and sat down together.
The room felt empty and very cold without any fire.
They knew that they had made a terrible mistake.
They have learned a hard lesson from this strange event today.
If the woman wanted more, she would lose everything again.
The old man hopes that they will stay happy in their small home.
Life near the water is quiet now, and they live in peace.
The fish swims far away and never comes back to the land.
Every afternoon, the man looks at the water and remembers the day.
He thinks about the wonderful fish and what happened then.
The wife never asks for anything else from the sea.
They eat simple food and share quiet moments every evening.
Sometimes they talk about the past and the big change.
The sun goes down, and light falls on the water.
They feel safe inside their little house by the sea.
The world around them is quiet and full of rest.
They know that simple life is better than too much power.
Hope stays with them as they live through their remaining years.

sentences.text: Once upon a time, an old man and his wife lived in a small house near the sea.
The man went out every day to catch fish in the water.
One afternoon, he caught a very strange fish that could speak like a human being.
The fish looked at the man and asked him to set it free back into the sea.
The kind man did not want to hurt the animal, so he let it go without any trouble.
When he returned home, he told his wife about the wonderful fish he had seen.
His wife became very angry and asked why he had not taken anything from the special creature.
She wanted a better house because their old one was small and poor.
The man went back to the sea and called for the fish, which appeared above the water.
The fish listened to the man and gave them a nice new house immediately.
However, the woman was still not happy after a few days passed.
She wanted more power and asked her husband to make her a ruler.
The man went back to the water again and asked the fish for another big change.
The special animal made her a ruler, but the woman wanted even more control over the whole world.
She finally asked to become like a god, which made the fish very angry.
When the husband returned to the sea to ask for this final wish, the weather turned bad.
The water became dark and wild as the fish took away all their new things.
The man and his wife were left back in their small, poor house once again.
Many years passed while the couple lived in that small house near the water.
Sometimes they thought about the special fish and the strange events that had happened.
The old man always remembered how the fish had spoken to him in the afternoon.
His wife often wished that she had been more patient with their simple life.
If she had kept her happiness, they would have stayed in the nice new house forever.
Instead, her great desire for power led to complete ruin and sadness.
The local people who heard the story often talked about the very difficult woman.
They agreed that people should always be glad for what they already possess.
Extreme desire only brings trouble, while a calm heart brings true joy.
Life by the sea went on quietly for the old man and his faithful wife.
Every morning, the man walked down to the shore to look at the blue waves.
He never saw the special fish again, but he often thought about that afternoon.
His wife learned a hard lesson about wanting too much power and control.
She spent her days working around the small house and helping her husband.
They did not need any more big changes or fancy things to be happy.
Their simple home was enough for them as they lived out their remaining years.
Whenever the wind blew hard over the water, they remembered the storm.
That terrible day stayed in their minds as a warning against boundless desire.
The man and woman stayed in their home and worked every single day.
They ate simple food and drank clean water from the nearby well.
The sun rose and set over the water while the seasons changed slowly.
They talked about the past and remembered the lessons they had learned.
The woman understood that her strong drive had destroyed their bright future.
She smiled at her husband because she finally appreciated his company.
They shared stories with people who visited the small local town.
Everyone agreed that simple lives were better than lives built on extreme demands.
The old couple found peace in each other during their final years together.
